minutes.headline: School Committee approved the FY24 recommended budget and the modified primary school air conditioning project, both by roll call.
minutes.summary: Held remotely, the meeting opened with a long committee statement in support of the social and emotional learning curriculum, then a budget public hearing with no public questions. The committee voted to approve the superintendent's recommended budget and, after discussion of scope and the town manager's process, a reduced air conditioning project at the primary school.

public_comment.topic: Asked whether the scaled-down primary school AC project would prevent further heat damage, whether its scope matches what town meeting approved, and what repairing existing damage would cost.

votes.motion: Approve the superintendent's recommended FY24 budget as presented
votes.outcome: passed 5-0 (roll call: beardmore, scombrini, Kelly, Leighton, Shambo all yes)

votes.motion: Approve the modified primary school air conditioning project as presented and send it on to the town manager
votes.outcome: passed 5-0 (roll call: all five members yes)

budget_items.what_was_said: The recommended budget is a two and a half percent increase over the FY23 budget, split between personnel and non-personnel costs.
The budget includes contractual step, longevity and degree increases and a health insurance increase based on new employees and enrollment.
Two new positions are funded locally: a humanities teacher at the high school and an enrollment/transportation/IEP process secretary, plus a general education transportation contract increase.
A targeted math teacher, a primary school psychologist, and the tier one SEL counselor would be funded by grants rather than the local budget; a licensed practical nurse depends on grant funding.
Custodian and cafeteria negotiations and some individual contracts are unsettled, and no COVID grant funding is known; grants are expected to be level-funded.
Circuit breaker is not released for some time but is expected to keep covering about the same share of out-of-district costs.
A member contrasted the cost of the modified project with the cost of cooling the whole building.

decisions.decision: If the committee approves, the superintendent will notify the town manager, who would take the modified AC project to the capital planning committee, finance committee and select board for consensus that it fits the original town meeting intent.
Administration will work with the facilities director to determine a minimal level of summer cooling for the primary school's hottest areas.

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved the superintendent's recommended FY24 budget as presented, 5-0 on a roll call.
The committee approved a modified, reduced primary school air conditioning project 5-0 by roll call and sent it on to the town manager.
If approved, the town manager would take the modified project to the capital planning committee, finance committee and select board to confirm it fits the original town meeting intent.
The recommended budget is described as a two and a half percent increase over FY23, with two new locally funded positions and several others dependent on grants.
Administration will work with the facilities director to set a minimal level of summer cooling for the primary school's hottest areas.

why_it_matters: The FY24 school budget vote sets the school side of the request that goes to town meeting, so it bears on the tax bill and on which positions are funded locally.
Several positions rest on grants rather than the local budget, so if grant funding changes, the cost could move onto the town budget, mostly taxes.
The air conditioning project was scaled down from what town meeting approved, so residents may be asked whether the reduced scope still matches that approval.
watch_next: Whether the capital planning committee, finance committee and select board agree that the modified primary school air conditioning project fits the original town meeting intent.
The outcome of custodian and cafeteria negotiations and the timing of circuit breaker release, which the budget discussion listed as unknown.
